run_binary_size_diff: run the binary size diff script comparing current gRPC Objective-C build against a base commit
run_binary_size_no_diff: run the binary size script without a diff base to measure current build sizes only
build_gRPC_objective_c_sample: build the gRPC Objective-C sample project with or without frameworks using the build function
get_size_gRPC_components: get the binary sizes of gRPC Core, ObjC, BoringSSL, Protobuf, and Total app components
dir_size_calculate_total: calculate the total size of all files in a directory tree recursively using dir_size
